text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the evening, I spot
Matikanefukukitaru
standing in a corner
of the training track, acting
somewhat
oddly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnnnn...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnn... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! It was light out a second ago, and
now it's
dark?! When did that happen?!
Ack, my knees
hurt!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniffle! You're willing to hear me out?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, actually... I'm in a real big pickle
right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It all happened the other day—just as
my
friend-making lucky item turned up...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, I can't thank you two enough!
With your
help, my precious
handkerchief is safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now I can rest assured we'll stay the best
of
friends!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Stay the best of friends?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Our friendship wouldn't exist
without my
lucky item!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hang on... So you're saying that we're
not friends
unless you have that
handkerchief?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you should try believing in us
more... And
yourself, too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
They got so mad at me! And the more I
think
about it, the more confused I get!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Our paths were intertwined by the grace of divine guidance, so why would that make them upset?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her lack of confidence has led her to
believe that
she can't make friends
without her lucky charm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that's what brought about the

misunderstanding.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What if the classroom was pent up
with
terrible energy? It must have
infected their
emotions... that explains
the negativity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to idly watch her imagination run
amok, I
give her my perspective.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: S-s-so my lucky charm is not the reason we're friends?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And saying that my friendships were all
created
through my lucky charm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Is what made them mad at me? Oh... now
that
makes sense...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Not! That would be preposterous! Why would they be friends with me then?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Say whaaat?! You've gotta be kidding!
The world
turning upside down is more
likely than that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Th-th-that makes no sense! Like that's
just...
ridicu—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She freezes on the spot again.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnnnn...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Do I... trust them?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course! I definitely trust them!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I trust them, so... Ah! I HAVE SEEN THE
LIGHT!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Those two are extraordinary
Umamusume... so by
saying that, I
discounted the extraordinary
decision
they made!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That was totally rude of me! I have to go
and
apologize to them right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, not much else to say then. See you
later!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Lucky daaash!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Go for a run?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for a change of pace. You and your
good
ideas! I'll get to that right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Running at full speed sent all my worldly

distractions packing! My body and mind
feel nice
and refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It got me thinking too—I'll talk it out
with them
properly tonight!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Go for a run?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for a change of pace. You and your
good
ideas! I'll get to that right now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Golly gee, thinking too much filled my
head with
all sorts of thoughts—good
and bad!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gee whiz, my mind is a mess! Hmmm, I
must aim
for greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
HUPPPPP! Eko, eko, azure seal! Eko,
eko, wall o'
rust!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she recites her strange incantation,
she pulls a
pencil out of nowhere and
rolls it on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... "Showing sincerity leads to good
fortune."
I knew it! I must apologize to
them right away!
